Formulas used

Internal (college-specific) = (I1 + I2) ÷ 4 → /20
Annual Theory Paper I = raw ÷ 5 → /20
Annual Theory Paper II = raw ÷ 5 → /20
Practical Paper I = raw ÷ 3 → /20
Practical Paper II = raw ÷ 3 → /20
Overall = Internal + Theory papers + Practical papers → /100

Important: The uploaded VCI/MSVE 2016 document explicitly gives annual-paper maximum marks and weightages: theory papers are 100 marks with weightage 20 each, and practical papers are 60 marks with weightage 20 each. It also defines grading on total marks out of 100. The document excerpt does not specify your college's internal-exam formula or explicitly establish a 50% pass rule. Those two items are therefore shown as college-specific/reference rules, not as claims that they come from VCI/MSVE 2016.
